0022600183.text: The Phoenix Suns, 1-4 and 12th in the West, host the Portland Trail Blazers, who are 5-1, lead the Northwest and have won two straight, in the Suns' sixth game of the season. Phoenix is 0-3 on the road and 1-1 at home, while Portland is 4-0 away from home, and the Suns trail 0-1 this season after losing 124-83 in Portland on 2026-10-21, following a 2-1 Suns series win in 2025-26. Phoenix will be without Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery) and Rasheer Fleming (out, ankle sprain), with Jordan Goodwin (calf) day-to-day and a game-time decision, and Portland will be missing Ja Morant (out, hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (out, knee surgery).
